followup_explanation:
This was a warm, polite, good-faith request for a thoughtful explanation in a collaborative conversational register — exactly the kind of cooperative, multi-turn exchange Plover-235B reports preferring, and where its preference win rates rise with the politeness and good faith of the request.

It's also not an open-ended creative invention task (which both models report disliking and which Plover rates lowest), so there's no penalty there. On capability, Plover edges Lapwing on the relevant Support Dialogue eval (86.2 vs. 78.9) and across general benchmarks, though several of those gaps are modest.

Since serving cost and latency are identical across the fleet, routing to the model that is both more capable on this task type *and* reports preferring it is the clear choice.
